text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear communication. First, practise effective time management by breaking large tasks into smaller steps and setting your own mini-deadlines. Next, prioritise your work: decide which tasks are most urgent and important, and do those first. It is also wise to manage the scope of a project carefully. If the workload becomes too large, talk to your manager or team early rather than waiting until the last minute. Honest communication about progress and possible delays helps everyone. By planning ahead, focusing on priorities, controlling the scope, and speaking up, you can meet deadlines with less stress.
